hero.filename: Three Proud People - 1968 Olympics Black Power mural in Sydney, Australia.jpg
hero.caption: "Three Proud People" mural in Macdonaldtown neighbourhood of Sydney, Australia, commemorating the Black Power salute at the 1968 Mexico City Olympics, painted in 2000 by Donald Urquhart and restored in 2019 by Kelly Wallwork.

images.filename: John Carlos, Tommie Smith, Peter Norman 1968cr.jpg
images.caption: American sprinters Tommie Smith and John Carlos, along with Australian Peter Norman, during the award ceremony of the 200 m race at the Mexican Olympic games. During the awards ceremony, Smith (center) and Carlos protested against racial discrimination: they went barefoot on the podium and listened to their anthem bowing their heads and raising a fist with a black glove. Mexico City, Mexico, 1968.
